title: Kicky Snappy American Black Olive Skewers
description: A citrusy and snappy American dish featuring black olives, yuzu-cure, and shojin-friendly ingredients, perfect for a quick snack or appetizer.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, ginger, sea salt, and black pepper.
Add the black olives to the bowl and toss to coat with the yuzu-cure mixture.
Thread 2-3 black olives onto each bamboo skewer.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes, or until the olives are slightly caramelized.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the Kicky Snappy American Black Olive Skewers warm or at room temperature.
